name: FleetPartners Group Ltd
summary: FleetPartners Group Limited is a specialist provider of fleet management solutions, operating throughout Australia and New Zealand. The company structures its operations across three primary divisions: Australia Commercial, Novated, and New Zealand Commercial. Its extensive service portfolio includes vehicle fleet leasing and administration, novated lease arrangements, and vehicle sales. These services are delivered under several well-known brands, namely FleetPlus, FleetPartners, FleetChoice, and 1800 Accident. Founded in 1987 and headquartered in St Leonards, Australia, the company underwent a name change from Eclipx Group Limited to FleetPartners Group Limited in March 2023.
